payload.body: HAND-OVER, ISSUE:0007's wiring, for your verdict. RANGE: 9cc5f93, 78cabdc, 802de63 on main (each committed by path; between them only other seats' intent records). THE ONE RUN, two Desk slots, on hv's go through your brief. Slot 1 (01M79VNKJ75Q7EFHCF89QQS4TW) at 78cabdc: bin/devbin check all green; cargo test --test cli 31 of 31. 78cabdc..802de63 changes no .rs or Cargo file, so those results stand for 802de63. Slot 2 (01M79W3Q2Y21ACP1BWREJA13GA) at 802de63, HEAD 8d015ee with only intent records after it: bats tests/macos.bats 45 of 45; bin/devbin build stamps ccusage 0.1.8 (dev, 8d015ee62072). bin/devbin install under a scratch HOME (the configured ~/Devel/opt/ccusage inside it) publishes bin/ccusage with .ccusage-install in T3's form, managed_by ccusage and line (opt, 8d015ee62072); the opt binary prints that line; a re-publish without --force is refused and --force replaces. use dev and use opt point the scratch link, and PATH's ccusage prints each tree's line. use brew, and a bare use with no link, fail on the pre-contract 0.1.8 keg (devbin 0348). doctor with the link on opt: 23 checks, 0 failed, every ccusage row ok. Outside the slots: shellcheck and actionlint on 802de63's bats and workflow; a v0.1.8 render with stand-in sums parses with ruby -c, and brew style finds no formula offense. ACCEPTANCE: 1, install and use dev/opt shown under a scratch HOME, and Ccusage's source holds no install or switch code; use brew waits for 0348 or the 0.1.9 keg. 2, (dev) from build and (opt) from the manifest shown; (brew) through the reader in tests/cli.rs's manifest test and the formula's test do; (unknown, unknown) from cargo test's unstamped build; doctor's dev row passes; no version verb. 3, the template's install is @@INSTALL@@ on both branches, and the render shows the asset layout and bin/devbin install --prefix libexec --managed-by brew; the kegs themselves come at 0.1.9's publish. 4, ccusage use NAME is untouched, and its tests pass. 5, T10 is hv's, after the publish. PLEASE READ: src/main.rs (the reader as one let chain), cli::run's fn parameter, tests/cli.rs's two version tests, config.yaml's install: and build: blocks, the template, macos's unpack (directory entries and the post-extract directory check), and the bats changes. NOT RUN HERE: the Linux keg's path, bin/devbin install in brew's build env, which T10's Linux leg covers. build.inputs is load-bearing there: brew puts .brew_home in the buildpath, and without declared inputs a first build reads the whole tree and refuses it as dirty. NOTE: from 78cabdc, macos finalize cannot re-verify a release cut before it (v0.1.8 and earlier), since those archives hold the old members. A SECOND ROUTE PAST 0348, for hv: doctor passes with the ccusage link on opt (or dev), and hv's PATH has ~/.local/bin ahead of Homebrew's bin. So bin/devbin install and use opt before the cut, which are T10's own first steps, and use brew after brew upgrade ccusage to 0.1.9's new-form keg, would get the cut through without devbin 0.1.24. It would run a local build against hv's real config, so it is hv's call under watch-out 1.
